content:
maria: Quick idea — run a 4-week community challenge called 'Build with Redwood: Mini Reference Apps' targeting devs who want hands-on examples. It combines a short tutorial series, a benchmark narrative blog (cost+latency), a demo webinar mid-series, and a single inbound form that routes qualified leads to eng demos. Thoughts?
kevin: love it. can we scope 3 mini refapps (chat plugin, retrieval qa, embeddings search) and ship 1 tutorial per week? keep them tiny (<= 300 LOC) so people fork quickly. :rocket:
ale ks: we should own the funnel early — have a single landing page + UTM'd links for each tutorial, then route high-engagers to a gated webinar signup. define thresholds: viewed > 2 tutorials OR ran the sample should trigger nurture.
jamal: webinar format — 30m walkthrough + 20m live dev challenge + Q&A. CTA: deploy to Redwood Hosted demo or request Dedicated trial if they're enterprise. also suggest an open leaderboard/gist for community submissions.
maria: schedule wise: week 0 landing + announce post, week 1 tutorial A + twitter thread, week 2 tutorial B + benchmark mini-post (bench vs baseline on 2 models), week 3 tutorial C + webinar, week 4 recap + community highlight post. does that pacing fit marketing calendar?
kevin: fits. for benchmark narrative we should call out real numbers: median p50 latency, cost per 1k tokens with batching, and a short appendix with run commands. can provide a lightweight harness and dataset (100 prompts) to reproduce.
kevin: sample README snippet for repo: ```
# Mini refapp: retrieval-qa
# Quickstart
git clone git@github.com:redwood/ref-mini-retrieval.git
cd ref-mini-retrieval
poetry install
# run local example
env REDWOOD_API_KEY=... python examples/run_demo.py
```
jamal: for inbound routing — use a single hidden field on the landing form: "workload_type" (prototype/scale/enterprise). route enterprise-tagged leads to sales queue, others into dev drip (3 emails: getting started, optimization tips, invite to webinar).
ale ks: on messaging iteration — A/B test two hero lines on week0 launch: 1) "Ship LLM features with predictable cost and latency" vs 2) "Reference apps + bench that prove performance". track CTRs and signups.
maria: please own the landing page copy + hero test (kevin can own refapp code + tutorial draft; aleks runs form + email flows; jamal owns webinar ops). I'll draft the top-level announcement post and coordinate community channels.
kevin: I'll drop the initial tutorial skeleton by EOD tomorrow. linking the repo boilerplate once up. :thumbsup:
ale ks: I'll wire the form and set up segment events. need the hero copy options from maria and the UTM scheme.
jamal: I'll reserve webinar slot, set up Zoom + recording settings, and craft the challenge prompts for live coding. will also spin up a lightweight scoring GH action for submissions.
ops-bot: Reminder: marketing-webpage deploy scheduled for 3823470000. Ping in #eng-oncall if there's a build issue.
maria: awesome team — thanks. next sync in #marketing tomorrow 10am PT. action items: kevin (tutorials + repo), aleks (form + routing), jamal (webinar ops), maria (announce copy + hero tests). :sparkles:
